reconciliation.notes: The official 70+ claim establishes a lower bound, not an exact active-pool count.
The public workbook has exactly one anchored preview in each sheet row 2-71.
An independent public index lists six release-era arenas absent from all 70 workbook internal-name rows.
The current build randomizes arenas and exposes no clean-room catalog browser.
